author: render-agent
note: ungraded per-product layers (RGBA, straight alpha) and shadows (grey RGB, multiply); grade_cut_r4.py grades and cuts them

vase.what: scaled in code to the card (Large D16 x H32), anchored at its current base; NOT moved (placement pending the designer)

before_cm.how: the card's cylinder projected at the vase's own base point is the ruler (H 32 = card height px, D 16 = card width px)

scale.why_two_factors: the render's height : width is ~2.3 : 1 against the card's 2 : 1 (QA: proportion partial), so each axis is brought to the card (QA's recipe: uniform unless the source proportion is wrong)

vase.shadow: the measured contact shadow (work/shadows/vase.png) shrunk about the same anchor at the foot's scale (sx, sx): it lies on the bench; 1 under the new full alpha; what the vase uncovers is the base's own window, frame and bench
vase.status: size fixed; placement pending the designer

pendant.what: the ceiling canopy re-cut whole from the R3b render (QA: half disc + separate crescent)
pendant.method: the ceiling canopy as one rigid convex piece: what is whiter than the ceiling (b* at least 2.5 lower) or differs from it (dE > 6),     in the canopy's box, above the cord's foot, the cord's own column left out; the largest component, closed (5 px disc) and filled to     its convex hull; the edge from a guided filter on the render (r 2): 1 in the hull eroded 1 px, 0 beyond 2 px. The cord: below row     62 a_old's own cut; between the canopy's foot and row 62 the cord's own alpha profile (the median of rows 62-90 across its column,     +-6 px: the cord hangs plumb), so nothing else of a_old above row 62 is kept (R3's half disc, its tail and the crescent)
pendant.rgb: the R3b render (work-r3/layers/pendant.png's own RGB), unchanged; shadow: none (all white), as in the slot

edges.what: the planter's left side re-matted where it meets the plain wall, and the grey crescent left of its mouth (R1's wider rim, carried into R3a) cut at the pot's own edge; the planter's and the basket's contact shadows no longer fade out next to them (the basket's light line, the planter's ghost); the basket's cut, colours and alpha are R3's
edges.rematte: the soft edge re-estimated from the render, in the selection only: F = the product's colour just inside (normalised blur over the     alpha core, eroded 3 px), B = the render's background just outside (2-7 px beyond the cut, on `bg`); per pixel of the edge band the     alpha is the projection of its colour on F - B (where |F - B| > 0.06; elsewhere the old alpha); the outline is smoothed at 4x (sigma     1 px) and anti-aliased; the colour in the band is un-mixed (C - (1 - a) B) / a toward F, so no background of the render stays in it
edges.shadow: R3's measured contact shadow, with the edge fix only: extract.shadow_one blurs the darkening with zeros inside the product and then     lightens the soft edge by (1 - a) + a, so within ~3 px of the product it fades out and a lighter strip shows between the product and     its shadow (the basket's light line, the planter's ghost). Here, within 3 px outside the product and on its soft edge (0 < a < 1),     each pixel takes the shadow R3 measured 3-4.5 px out from the product (a sigma-2.5 blur normalised over that ring, so it follows the     edge and tapers where R3's shadow ends), never lighter than R3's own value     and, where that is a real shadow (<= 0.85), never lighter than the render's own darkening right there (the contact occlusion; at most     20 % deeper); everywhere else the shadow is R3's, unchanged

planter.selection: the pot's left side, rows 1046-1205, x 935-1010, off the basket (+3 px) and off its R3 contact shadow (+4 px)

rim_clip.line: x = -0.1228 y + 1093.72 (the pot's left edge on rows 1056-1075)

floor-lamp.what: the shade fabric toned to the designer's targets (section 5), so the product layer reads off; the collar, stem, base and chain keep their pixels; the light comes from the light layer later (code)

method.low_frequencies: replaced by T(u, v) = Lmid + G (0.5 - u) - D smoothstep((v - v0) / (v1 - v0)) in graded L* (u across the shade's columns, v down its rows); b* low = bT at the fabric's own hue
method.folds: the raw's high-pass (L*, a*, b*) about a normalised sigma-8 blur over the fabric (the folds are ~3-9 px apart), L* detail x s so the graded high-pass std stays at the r3 value (the grade's shoulder no longer compresses it)
method.warmth: b* soft knee from ring p95 + 5.6, never past ring p95 + 7.4
method.soft_edge: the alpha < 1 rim keeps its render mix plus alpha x the fabric's local change

floor-lamp.note: targets measured with QA's p2_lamp.py masks on the graded set-B scene; the final numbers are re-measured by grade_cut_r4.py on the r4 scene
